translations.web: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.
translations.bsb: And they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
translations.kjv: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
translations.asv: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him: and Jehovah shut him in.
